known.via: English Wikipedia "Coteaux du Layon AOC" (redirects to "Coteaux du Layon")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation for sweet white wine, made from Chenin along the River Layon in Anjou. Six villages, such as Beaulieu-sur-Layon and Saint-Aubin-de-Luigné, may add their name to the label.
